hermeticity.method: I formed the baseline from 100:8 and its three focus branch inventories alone, then treated the context roots in packet order as possible activators while requiring every retained reading to return to حُبِّ, خَيْرِ, شَدِيدٌ, or their construction.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed one-call trace because the sealed packet exposed the focus ayah and all context simultaneously. It records recoverable baseline-to-context changes, not a temporally blind staged log, and it uses no material beyond the prompt, schema, packet, and ordinary Arabic morphology and syntax.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ joins ح ب ب as clinging attachment, خ ي ر as desired benefit, and ش د د as a fastened bond.
baseline_models.mechanism: The three focus roots yield a relational mechanism: something judged beneficial attracts preference, preference clings, and the doubled lām construction culminates in a predicate of tight fastening. شَدِيدٌ therefore describes not only degree but how firmly the subject is bound to the desired good.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Love is an attachment that remains with the heart.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the persistent attachment in the focus relation.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The good is what is inclined toward as beneficial.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the attachment's positively valued object.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A bond is tied and made firm.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Turns intensity into the firmness of the subject-object bond.

changed_reading.before: He loves the good very intensely.
changed_reading.after: He is tightly fastened to what he takes to be good; the verse profiles the tenacity of the bond, not merely a large quantity of affection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حُبِّ can be clinging preference, خَيْرِ can be beneficence or gift, and شَدِيدٌ has a branch explicitly naming miserliness.
baseline_models.mechanism: A received or available gift becomes an object of possessive attachment. Because the ش د د inventory permits severity as miserliness, the predicate can diagnose retention: love of giving-as-object becomes unwillingness to let the gift pass onward.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Preference clings to the heart.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes possession emotionally adhesive.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Khayr can image beneficence, giving, or a gift.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Recasts the object from abstract goodness as transferable bounty.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Severity can denote miserliness.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes withholding, rather than emotional volume alone, the predicate's function.

changed_reading.before: He has an intense love of goodness.
changed_reading.after: He clings severely to bounty and is tight-fisted with what could circulate as a gift.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Within the focus inventories, خَيْرِ can be the better option selected, حُبِّ can be preference, and شَدِيدٌ can image a forceful charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: Selection supplies a target, attachment supplies directional preference, and the charge branch of ش د د converts that preference into pursuit. The predicate can therefore be kinetic: desire does not merely sit in the subject but drives him toward the preferred outcome.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Shidda can image a forceful charge or run.

changed_reading.before: He feels strongly about the good.
changed_reading.after: He drives hard toward the option he prefers; شَدِيدٌ can profile pursuit as well as feeling.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun حُبِّ activates the branch حبة القلب سويداؤه, while خَيْرِ activates selection and شَدِيدٌ activates a firm bond.
baseline_models.mechanism: The selected good is lodged at the heart's inner kernel and held there by a tightened bond. This produces an inward-causal reading: the verse identifies a compact motive at the subject's core from which conduct can issue.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The root can image the heart's innermost kernel.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Khayr can be what is selected as the better option.

changed_reading.after: The verse locates a tightly bound valuation in the heart's kernel, presenting love as a hidden causal core.

context_deltas.mechanism: Running plus audible breath gives the focus-only charge model a bodily cost. The packet supplies motion and panting; I infer that the preference named in 100:8 can function as the drive that sustains exertion. شَدِيدٌ becomes force expended under attachment, not a static emotional measurement.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A lasting preference remains attached.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the drive that persists through effort.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The good is a sought or selected outcome.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Severity can be a forceful charge or run.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The context supplies running and swift movement.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Externalizes the charge latent in شَدِيدٌ.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The context supplies an exertive breath or sound.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Marks the bodily cost and persistence of the drive.

structural_cues: The first context unit couples an agentive motion image with its audible bodily consequence.
The focus predicate شَدِيدٌ can echo that earlier exertive register through its own charge branch.

abductive_moves.assumption: The earlier exertion can illuminate the later predicate without making the runner itself the independent subject of 100:8.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: 100:1 supplies running and panting; 100:8 supplies love, selected good, and a charge branch for شَدِيدٌ.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: Attachment to the selected good energizes sustained pursuit.
alternatives: The opening motion may remain scene imagery with no causal relation to the focus motive.
شَدِيدٌ may retain only its degree or firmness sense.

changed_reading.before: A forceful-pursuit sense was only a focus-internal possibility.
changed_reading.after: The context gives that pursuit lungs and effort: love of the preferred good is a drive capable of sustaining a hard run.

context_deltas.ablation: Without either the running image or its exertive sound, the kinetic focus branch remains possible but loses the contextual evidence that intensity is enacted through bodily effort.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a latent fire brought out by striking. I assign the directional arrow: a contact or friction event activates an inward attachment into visible energetic output. The remote ح ب ب spark branch adds a disturbing qualification: brilliance can be weak or useless even when its declared object is خَيْر.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Khayr is what is desired as beneficial.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Creates the paradoxical test: does the energy actually produce the benefit it names?

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The predicate supplies intensity and force.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Gives the ignition high energetic amplitude.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Fire lies latent and comes out from the fire-stick.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Models attachment as stored energy awaiting activation.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Striking kindles fire.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the activating event that makes the latent motive flare.

structural_cues: The ignition pair follows the exertive pair, allowing motion, friction, and flare to form a rising energy sequence.
The focus combines an attachment noun with an emphatic force predicate, a shape compatible with stored energy becoming output.

abductive_moves.assumption: Physical ignition can serve as a material analogy for motive activation.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: 100:2 supplies latent fire and striking; 100:8 supplies attachment, benefit, force, and a remote spark branch.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The love is an inward combustible disposition that circumstances can strike into action.
alternatives: The fire imagery may describe only the earlier agents' motion.
The ح ب ب spark branch may be too form-distant to bear more than exploratory weight.

changed_reading.before: Love is a continuously present strong attachment.
changed_reading.after: Love is also latent combustible energy: it can be struck into forceful action, yet its sparks may prove spectacular and non-beneficial despite being directed toward what is called good.

context_deltas.ablation: Removing the ح ب ب spark branch leaves a generic fire metaphor; removing the two 100:2 ignition branches leaves the remote focus branch unactivated and causally inert.

context_deltas.mechanism: Displacement produces a cloud, entry reaches a center, and scattered parts are gathered. The packet supplies that trajectory; I infer that the selected good in 100:8 can occupy the role of the concentrated object toward which attachment drives. The reading changes from pursuit in open space to forceful penetration and accumulation.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Attachment persists toward its object.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Maintains direction through the contextual sequence.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The good is a selected or sought option.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Shidda can be a forceful charge.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Raised dust forms a cloud.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the pursuit materially disruptive and obscuring.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The action enters or places something in the middle.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Scattered parts are joined into a collected thing.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the concentration toward which the force moves.

structural_cues: The repeated fa-linked actions progress from stirring, through a material wake, to entering the middle of a gathering.
The sequence narrows spatially from open movement to a center, while 100:8 narrows value onto one preferred good.

abductive_moves.assumption: The gathered center can model the object-domain of desire without being equated lexically with خَيْر.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: The context supplies displacement, dust, entry, and gathering; the focus supplies selected good, attachment, and charge.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: Desire aims not merely to approach but to penetrate and concentrate what it values.
alternatives: The gathered center may be unrelated to the focus object's semantics.
The sequence may illustrate force without accumulation.

changed_reading.before: He forcefully pursues a preferred good.
changed_reading.after: His attachment drives an incursive movement into the center of concentration; the desired good is imagined as something to reach, penetrate, and gather.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the middle-plus-gathering pair, the model collapses back to undirected exertion; without the charge branch of شَدِيدٌ, the contextual sequence does not alter the focus predicate's function.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant ء ث ر mapping for أَثَرْ supplies self-monopolization, while the next ayah supplies gathering. Joined to خَيْر as choosing and شَدِيد as miserliness, these cues revise attachment into exclusive appropriation: the subject selects what is better, gathers it, and reserves it for himself.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Preference adheres to the heart.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Khayr can involve selecting the better option.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the act of preferential selection.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Severity can be miserliness.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Turns selection into restrictive retention.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The split mapped branch images monopolizing a thing for oneself.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Introduces exclusive self-allocation as the changed mechanism.

structural_cues: The packet places أَثَرْ before entry into جَمْعًا, allowing the alternative mapped self-preference branch to act on a subsequent collection.
The focus itself juxtaposes preference with a predicate that can denote miserliness.

abductive_moves.assumption: The accepted non-dominant ء ث ر branch can activate a focus reading even though it is not the dominant mapping of the context root.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: A mapped branch for self-monopolization, a gathered collection, focus selection, and focus miserliness.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The selected good is gathered under exclusive self-claim.
alternatives: The dominant ث و ر displacement reading may be the only contextually active one.
Selection may remain evaluative without becoming appropriation.

changed_reading.before: He withholds a gift because attachment is severe.
changed_reading.after: He preferentially selects and gathers what he calls good under an exclusive claim for himself; miserliness is the closure of a choice-and-collection mechanism.

context_deltas.ablation: Removing the non-dominant ء ث ر branch removes monopolization and leaves only accumulation; removing the focus miserliness branch removes the exclusive closure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places nurture and completion beside cutting and ingratitude for favor or affection. Those supplied relations revise the focus gift model: the subject adheres to the benefit while severing reciprocity with its nurturing giver. شَدِيد as miserliness is therefore relational asymmetry, not just private greed.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Love is a clinging attachment.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Explains why the subject keeps hold of the benefit.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Khayr can be generosity or gift.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the desired object something received and transferable.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Severity can name miserliness.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Defines the failure to return or circulate benefit.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The relation supplies cultivation, nurture, and completion.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the giver-side process from which benefit comes.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Kanūd images cutting and separation.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Severs the subject's relation to the source while attachment to the gift remains.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Kanūd names denial of favor and affection.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Identifies the reciprocity failure produced by the cut.

structural_cues: 100:6 establishes a subject-to-rabb relation immediately before 100:8 specifies the subject-to-khayr relation.
The emphatic إنّ ... لَ frame in 100:6 recurs around the focus, encouraging the two relations to be read together.

abductive_moves.assumption: The gift sense of خَيْر can be evaluated against the preceding nurture and ingratitude relation.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Nurture/completion, severance, denial of favor, love as attachment, gift as khayr, and miserliness as shidda.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The subject binds himself to the received benefit while cutting acknowledgment and return toward its source.
alternatives: Khayr may remain general good rather than received beneficence.
Shadīd may mean only strong attachment without withholding.

changed_reading.before: He is miserly because he loves bounty.
changed_reading.after: He preserves the bounty-side of a relation while cutting the giver-side: intense attachment to the gift and ingratitude toward nurture are one asymmetric mechanism.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the cutting branch, the model becomes generic ingratitude; without nurture and gift, it loses the specific asymmetry between clinging to benefit and severing relation to its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-parallel وَإِنَّهُ ... لَشَهِيدٌ and وَإِنَّهُ ... لَشَدِيدٌ frames place testimony beside severity. The packet supplies a witnessing sign; I infer that the severe bond to the selected good is itself the sign that makes the preceding relational failure legible. A private motive becomes evidence.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Love can image the heart's inner kernel.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the otherwise hidden interior fact.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Khayr is the preferred selection.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Identifies what the sign reveals the subject to have chosen.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The attachment is tied into a firm bond.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the hidden preference stable enough to leave an evidentiary pattern.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A mark serves as a witness.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Converts the focus's severe attachment into diagnostic evidence.

structural_cues: Adjacent ayat repeat وَإِنَّهُ and an emphatic lām predicate, with شَهِيدٌ followed by شَدِيدٌ.
The small consonantal and rhythmic shift between the two predicates encourages evidence and severity to interact without collapsing their roots.

abductive_moves.assumption: The parallel syntax makes the second predicate evidentiary with respect to the first.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: A witnessing mark in 100:7, a firm inner bond in 100:8, and closely parallel clause frames.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The pattern of attachment visibly testifies to the subject's orientation.
alternatives: 100:7 may state self-witness independently and 100:8 may merely add another trait.
The formal parallel may be rhetorical reinforcement without causal linkage.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a hidden but strong valuation.
changed_reading.after: The strength of that valuation is itself a witnessing mark: what grips the heart becomes evidence of what the subject has chosen and of the relation he has cut.

minimal_triggers: The adjacent وَإِنَّهُ ... لَشَهِيدٌ / وَإِنَّهُ ... لَشَدِيدٌ parallel
context_deltas.ablation: Without the adjacent parallel frames, the witness branch can still concern awareness but no longer strongly changes 100:8 from motive-description into evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence moves from knowing, through overturning what is hidden, to extracting an inner kernel from the chests and knowing the affair's inside. Those packet elements revise the heart-core baseline into a forensic mechanism: the tightly bound selection named in 100:8 is the buried causal kernel that later exposure isolates.

The outer-to-inner progression reverses the earlier outward motion and makes the focus's heart-kernel branch newly functional.
Passive exposure verbs shift agency away from the subject whose attachment had driven the earlier models.

abductive_moves.assumption: The material operations on buried and enclosed things can model disclosure of the focus motive.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Burial, overturning, kernel extraction, chests as sources of acts, and knowledge of the interior.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The severe love in 100:8 is the compact interior cause that these operations expose.
alternatives: The post-focus operations may concern separate objects without specifying the motive in 100:8.
حُبِّ may remain ordinary affection without activating the heart-kernel image.

abductive_moves.assumption: What is extracted from the chest can explain prior outward action.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: The chest branch names an origin of acts; the focus supplies a selected and firmly bound valuation.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: Exposure reveals not just a feeling but the source-code of conduct.
alternatives: The extracted content may be an inventory of deeds rather than their motive.

changed_reading.before: Love of the selected good is a hidden firm bond in the heart.
changed_reading.after: That bond is the buried causal kernel of conduct: the later sequence overturns its cover, extracts it from the action-producing chest, and renders its inward selection fully knowable.

context_deltas.ablation: Without kernel extraction from the chests, the burial imagery yields only general exposure; without the focus heart-kernel branch, the post-focus sequence cannot specifically revise the semantics of حُبِّ.

surprising_valid_outliers.why_surprising: It uses the non-dominant ع و د target embedded in the packet's split mapping for عَٰدِيَٰتِ, shifting from one forceful run to practiced recurrence.
surprising_valid_outliers.why_still_valid: The packet explicitly preserves that mapped target and its habit branch, while the focus supplies clinging attachment, repeated choice, and fastening. The resulting loop remains anchored in the construction لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حُبِّ as clinging attachment and شَدِيدٌ as fastening make a repeatable preference-loop; خَيْرِ supplies the repeatedly selected outcome.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Attachment remains with the heart.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies persistence across repetitions.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The better option is sought and selected.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the repeatedly preferred target.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The bond is fastened.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Stabilizes the loop into a hard-to-break pattern.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The split target images habit, training, and persistence.

changed_reading.before: Love of the good drives a forceful episode of pursuit.

surprising_valid_outliers.rendering_caution: Do not claim that عَٰدِيَٰتِ lexically means habit here. This is an activation from an accepted non-dominant mapped root, useful as a model of compulsion but form-distant and exploratory.

surprising_valid_outliers.why_surprising: It reads the focus through the material seed branch of ح ب ب and the barren-earth branch of ك ن د, making attachment an ecological failure rather than only an emotion.
surprising_valid_outliers.why_still_valid: The focus itself supplies seed-kernel, gift, and binding branches; 100:6 supplies both nurture and land that does not grow. The inference concerns what tight possession does to the focus good, so it remains anchored.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حُبِّ as seed-grain, خَيْرِ as gift, and شَدِيدٌ as fastening support an image of potentially fruitful good held too tightly to be released.

changed_reading.before: The subject moves toward the good because he loves it.
changed_reading.after: The direction can reverse: the presented good lures the hidden attachment into the open, revealing what the subject is tightly bound to when concealment is overturned.

surprising_valid_outliers.rendering_caution: This is a deliberately strange directional reversal licensed by branch and sequence, not a claim that خَيْرِ straightforwardly means bait in 100:8.

discarded_or_unchanged: 100:3 صُبْحًا and its root_000839 morning branches timed the earlier action but did not independently change a focus-anchored reading beyond the kinetic model.
The focus ح ب ب branches for teeth, small stature, a jar, and water bubbles did not produce a distinct mechanism stronger than the retained binding, ignition, seed, or heart-kernel readings.
100:11 خ ب ر branches for soft soil, husbandry, abundance, and soft vegetation did not change 100:8 beyond the retained inner-knowledge endpoint.
The proper-name, animal-name, and isolated body-part branches in several context inventories failed to return coherently to حُبِّ, خَيْرِ, or شَدِيدٌ and were left inactive.

strongest_changes: شَدِيدٌ changed from a scalar adjective into the firmness, exertion, and at times miserliness of an attachment mechanism.
The 100:6 gift relation changed love of khayr into an asymmetry: clinging to received benefit while cutting reciprocity with its nurturing source.
The adjacent شَهِيدٌ / شَدِيدٌ frames changed private attachment into a witnessing mark of the subject's chosen orientation.
The 100:9-11 exposure sequence changed حُبِّ into a buried heart-kernel that is extracted from the source of actions and made inwardly known.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations were not broad themes but reversals of function: movement became motive, gift became a severed relation, severity became evidence, and an inward heart-kernel became an excavated cause. Accepted split mappings also preserved live minority models of recurrence, monopolization, and surplus detached from nurture.
remaining_uncertainties: The construction permits live competition among intensity, firm attachment, forceful pursuit, and miserliness; the packet does not force one predicate function.
خَيْرِ may remain general benefit, selected betterment, or transferable gift, and each scope changes the social mechanism.
The kinetic context clearly energizes the focus, but assigning the gathered center as the object-domain of desire is an explicit reader inference.
The spark, barren-seed, coaxing-lure, and non-dominant split-root readings are traceable but intentionally exploratory and should not be lexicalized as settled senses.
